tagline: 柯尼卡取景器相机，1986 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1986年推出的取景器相机。配备Konica 36 mm, f/4 (4 elements in 4 groups).。快门速度Fixed shutter speed of 1/125s.。使用Motorwind.。感光度Aperture coupled to selected film speed: f/8 for ISO 100, f/11 for ISO 200, and f/16 for ISO 400.。Fixed focus, 1,5 m to infinity.。

specs.镜头: Konica 36 mm, f/4 (4 elements in 4 groups).
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, manually activated. Toggle for close distances.
specs.感光度: Aperture coupled to selected film speed: f/8 for ISO 100, f/11 for ISO 200, and f/16 for ISO 400.
specs.英文简介: Part of the MT (Multi) series of compact cameras from Konica, the MT-7 was the most basic model.
